description.value: Trees Organic Coffee is a Vancouver institution founded in 1996, now operating 13–14 locations across the city under the Trees Cheesecake & Organic Coffee brand. The King Edward Village branch on Kingsway serves the chain's signature small-batch roasted organic coffee alongside its award-winning homemade cheesecakes, sandwiches, and baked goods. A combination of corporately run and franchised cafes, Trees also hosts live music nights at select locations, making it a lively neighbourhood stop.
